title: 2.5.11 Fix the Silent Catch
description: An empty catch block is hiding a failure. Add a report so the next person can see it. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed — practice for 2.5.2 Context Pause (the empty catch block)

steps.title: Find the silent catch
steps.instructions: The starter's catch block is empty. Nothing tells you the order total failed to calculate.

steps.title: Report it
steps.instructions: Add a console.log inside the catch block that says what happened, for example "Could not calculate the total."
